name: asset-manager-showpune Assessment Report
description: Application assessment for cloud migration readiness

issues.title: AWS S3 SDK Dependency
issues.description: Application uses AWS S3 SDK (software.amazon.awssdk:s3) which is AWS-specific and needs to be replaced with Azure Blob Storage for Azure migration.
issues.message: AWS S3 SDK is used for object storage operations. This needs to be migrated to Azure Blob Storage SDK.
issues.recommendation: Replace AWS S3 SDK with Azure Blob Storage SDK (com.azure:azure-storage-blob). Refactor AwsS3Service to use Azure BlobServiceClient and BlobContainerClient.
remediationPlan: Add Azure Blob Storage SDK dependency (com.azure:azure-storage-blob:12.25.1)
Create AzureBlobService to replace AwsS3Service
Update configuration properties from aws.s3.* to azure.storage.*
Implement Azure Managed Identity (DefaultAzureCredential) for authentication
Update worker module S3FileProcessingService to use Azure Blob Storage

issues.title: RabbitMQ Messaging Dependency
issues.description: Application uses RabbitMQ (spring-boot-starter-amqp) for message queue communication between web and worker modules. Consider migrating to Azure Service Bus for native Azure integration.
issues.message: RabbitMQ is used for async messaging. Azure Service Bus provides a managed alternative with better Azure integration.
issues.recommendation: Migrate from RabbitMQ to Azure Service Bus using spring-cloud-azure-starter-servicebus. Use Azure Managed Identity for authentication.
remediationPlan: Add Azure Service Bus dependency (com.azure.spring:spring-cloud-azure-starter-servicebus)
Replace RabbitConfig with ServiceBusMessagingConfig
Update message sending code to use ServiceBusTemplate or JmsTemplate
Configure Azure Service Bus queue and authentication
Update worker module to consume messages from Azure Service Bus

issues.title: PostgreSQL Database Dependency
issues.description: Application uses PostgreSQL database for metadata storage. Consider migrating to Azure Database for PostgreSQL for managed service benefits.
issues.message: PostgreSQL is used for persistence. Azure provides a managed PostgreSQL service with better integration.
issues.recommendation: Migrate to Azure Database for PostgreSQL. Update connection strings to use Azure PostgreSQL endpoints with Azure AD authentication.
remediationPlan: Provision Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server
Update application.properties with Azure PostgreSQL connection string
Configure Azure AD authentication for database access
Migrate existing database schema and data
Test database connectivity and operations

issues.title: Missing Authentication Mechanism
issues.description: Application does not implement authentication or authorization. Public endpoints are exposed without security controls.
issues.message: No authentication or authorization is configured. All endpoints are publicly accessible.
issues.recommendation: Implement authentication using Azure AD (Entra ID) with Spring Security and spring-cloud-azure-starter-active-directory.
remediationPlan: Add Spring Security and Azure AD dependencies
Configure Azure AD authentication in application properties
Add security annotations to controllers (@PreAuthorize)
Implement role-based access control (RBAC)
Test authentication flows

issues.title: Profile-Based Configuration
issues.description: Application uses Spring profiles (!dev) for environment-specific configuration. This pattern works well for cloud migration but needs Azure-specific profile.
issues.message: Profile-based configuration is in place but needs Azure profile configuration.
issues.recommendation: Add 'azure' profile with Azure-specific service implementations. Maintain 'dev' profile for local development.
remediationPlan: Create application-azure.properties with Azure configuration
Add @Profile("azure") to Azure-specific service implementations
Update deployment configuration to activate 'azure' profile
Document profile usage in README

issues.title: Spring Boot Version
issues.description: Application uses Spring Boot 3.2.1. Consider upgrading to latest LTS version (3.4.x) for better Azure integration and security updates.
issues.message: Spring Boot 3.2.1 is used. Newer versions provide better cloud features and security patches.
issues.recommendation: Upgrade to Spring Boot 3.4.x for latest features, security patches, and improved Azure SDK compatibility.
remediationPlan: Update spring-boot-starter-parent version to 3.4.5
Test application thoroughly after upgrade
Update any deprecated APIs if necessary

issues.title: Missing Application Monitoring
issues.description: Application lacks comprehensive monitoring and observability features. No integration with Azure Monitor or Application Insights.
issues.message: No monitoring or telemetry is configured. Azure Application Insights should be integrated for production readiness.
issues.recommendation: Add Azure Application Insights for distributed tracing, logging, and metrics collection.
remediationPlan: Add spring-cloud-azure-starter-monitor dependency
Configure Application Insights connection string
Enable auto-instrumentation for requests, dependencies, and exceptions
Add custom metrics and traces as needed

issues.title: Hardcoded Configuration Values
issues.description: Application may contain hardcoded configuration values. Use Azure Key Vault for sensitive configuration.
issues.message: Configuration values should be externalized to Azure Key Vault for better security.
issues.recommendation: Migrate sensitive configuration to Azure Key Vault and use spring-cloud-azure-starter-keyvault-secrets for integration.
remediationPlan: Add Azure Key Vault dependency
Provision Azure Key Vault instance
Move sensitive configuration to Key Vault
Configure application to read from Key Vault
Use Managed Identity for Key Vault access
